The diagram shows Mini's rectangular garden as a closed figure. Side lengths are marked in metres.

What is the perimeter of the garden?

teacher.key_rationale: Perimeter adds the boundary once: 9+4+9+4=26 m. 13 m adds length and width once only. 36 m is the area. 18 m uses an incomplete boundary total.
